guardian.title: Fees and payments
guardian.notFoundText: This student is not linked to your mobile number. If that seems wrong, please tell the institute's office.

summary.title: Fees
summary.allPaidText: Nothing is owed right now. Thank you!
summary.pending: {n, plural, one {# payment is} other {# payments are}} waiting to be checked
summary.payAtOffice: You can also pay in cash at the office.

dues.empty: No fees have been added yet.
dues.pending: Your payment for this is waiting to be checked

submissions.title: Your bKash/Nagad payments
submissions.pendingHint: You will get a receipt by SMS once the institute has checked it.
submissions.rejectHint: If something was wrong, submit again with the right details. If you are unsure, contact the office.

payments.title: Payment receipts
payments.empty: No receipts yet. A receipt appears here once a payment is recorded.

pay.noAccounts: The institute has not shared a bKash or Nagad number yet. You can pay at the office.
pay.pendingFull: {n, plural, one {# payment is} other {# payments are}} still waiting to be checked. You can report another once they are checked.
pay.title: Pay by bKash/Nagad
pay.sendText: Send the money from your bKash or Nagad app to the number below. Keep the SMS you get back: you will need it in the next step.
pay.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please write the number down.
pay.accountRequired: Choose the number you sent the money to.
pay.duesHint: Tick the fees this money is for.
pay.duesMax: You can choose up to {max} fees at a time.
pay.duePending: An earlier payment is waiting to be checked
pay.amountHint: The total of the chosen fees is filled in. If you sent less, enter what you sent.
pay.amountTooMuch: This is more than the chosen fees ({amount} at most). If you sent more, tick more fees or tell the office.
pay.trxHint: It is in the SMS bKash/Nagad sends after the payment, next to “TrxID” (e.g. 9JK3L2M8XQ). You can also find it in the app's transaction list.
pay.trxInvalid: A TrxID has 6 to 20 letters and digits. Check the SMS and type it again.
pay.trxUsed: This TrxID has already been used. Check it against the SMS.
pay.senderHint: The bKash/Nagad number the money came from.
pay.successText: The institute will check the payment and send you a receipt by SMS. You can follow it on this page too.

errors.amountExceeds: These fees come to {amount} now: enter that or less.
errors.tooManyPending: {max} payments for this child are still waiting to be checked. Submit again once they are checked.
errors.accountInactive: The institute no longer uses this number. The list is updated: choose another number.
errors.rateLimited: Too many submissions in a short time. Try again in {n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.changed: The fees changed meanwhile. The list is updated: check it and submit again.
errors.check: Some details need fixing: see the messages below.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.notFound: This receipt could not be found.
